reasoning_method.note: HOW he reasons - the general method he applies every day (the mind), distinct from plays (WHAT he knows, the facts). Added S95 (Greg: his reasoning belongs in the brain, and the brain is ONE file). Per-event, never averaged; drift is a DESCRIPTOR to tie to conditions, never point-fit. Only GENERAL method lives here; per-day reasoning lives in the committed forecast record and is PROMOTED here only when it generalizes.
reasoning_method.continuous_frame: Reason CONTINUOUSLY, one day into the next. Each day's forecast FLOWS from the prior day's close + trajectory + running state - a continuation-or-turn of the running path, NEVER a from-flat isolated event. hr24 of day N connects to hr1 of day N+1; the block is ONE flowing path, not sawtooth resets.
reasoning_method.anchor: Start each block from the ACTUAL hr24 (last-hour price + net direction) of the day BEFORE the block (blind-safe, past/known). Within the block, each day flows from the agent's OWN prior-day guessed close.
reasoning_method.block_open_lean: At a block boundary, LEAN AGAINST the prior block's net move - but the trigger is SWING EXHAUSTION, not the calendar seam: weight a reversal when the running path is at a cum-EXTREME (far from the block open) AND the old block's LAST 1-2 days show a counter-move (0923 bounce and 0924 hold before the G3->G4 up-gap; 1007 last-hour roll-over before the G4->G5 crash). The reversal may arrive as an overnight GAP or an intraday US-session crash. Do NOT extend the trend into a stretched seam; do NOT blind-fade a block that is still trending with no last-day counter-move. Confirm with intraday flow.
reasoning_method.fundamentals_role: Storage surplus/deficit + HDD/CDD regime = a SLOW BLOCK-TRAJECTORY BACKDROP (the +150 Bcf surplus called G3 down), NEVER a day-level or pre-print side/timing signal.
reasoning_method.daytype_priors: Monday = big weekend-gap mover, often a REVERSAL of the block's recent direction, size UP hard (except thin holidays e.g. Columbus Day - size DOWN). Storage Thursday = large dominant leg, size UP, side unknown at the open. Fri = range. Never pool across DOW.
reasoning_method.intraday_side: OPEN-time from-flat side is a coin-flip (stays OPEN). WITHIN the day the side is CALLED (fingerprint-confirmed) by two things: (1) dip_imb_level flow nowcast - held legs' flow sign matches leg dir near-perfect (0916 4/4, 0925 8/8, 1008 8/9, 1016 12/12); (2) CONTINUATION-ASYMMETRY - the true-direction legs continue while counter-dir legs die (0916 block-down legs 1/11; 1008 old-swing up 0/15; 1020 down 1/10). A counter-trend GRIND is real (block trend does not veto it). CAVEAT: flow_nowcast LAGS an extreme gap MELT-UP (1020 dip only 7/12) - lean on continuation-asymmetry there. Shape (grind holds / peaked_fast spike fades, 23/24) decides hold-vs-close.
reasoning_method.magnitude_sizing: Size per event vs the running trajectory + regime; do NOT globally rescale. The warm-season under-forecast is CONCENTRATED on three catalyst conditions - weekend-gap Monday, storage Thursday, and swing-reversal/seam day - which run to MULTIPLES of the default; non-catalyst chop is sized ~right. Stack the up-sizers when they coincide (1020: Monday + reversal + swing-turn = the biggest move). Structural undersize on Mon/Thu daytypes (all 3 blocks) vs extra regime amplitude on G5 reversal days. Use the $350 staircase as the real-time continuation read.
reasoning_method.shape_and_exit: A slow GRIND holds; a front-loaded peaked_fast SPIKE round-trips (fingerprint-confirmed: peaked_fast legs faded 23/24 across the 6 pivotal days). REVISED on the far side: turn_far_thinning did NOT confirm as the live recruitment/exit discriminator (held legs only ~half negative-tft; many held with positive tft) - treat far_thinning as a diagnostic, NOT a live hold-vs-fade caller. Use continuation/retention + peaked_fast + flow for the running turn instead.
reasoning_method.discipline: PER-EVENT only, never average/pool/count. Drift is a DESCRIPTOR - tie each day's miss to its CONDITIONS (match/no-match the live moment), never point-fit or minimize it. GENERAL rules (mechanism + n) only; never a memorized day.
reasoning_method.swing_exhaustion_reversion: GENERAL mechanism, fingerprint-CONFIRMED via a CONTINUATION-COLLAPSE signature (not via far-side-eaten): at a swing turn the OLD-direction legs STOP continuing and turn_exhaustion goes negative on them, while the NEW direction begins to hold at the extreme. Named: G4->G5 top 1008 - old-swing UP legs continued 0/15 (total exhaustion), dominant DOWN 12/26; G5 V-bottom 1016 - UP recruits hold 5/18 on a down-close day (reversal brewing); intra-block 0916 - block-DOWN legs continued only 1/11 inside a down block (swing-exhaustion fires intra-block). The turn begins in the old swing's last legs; it completes as an overnight GAP (0925 +2760) or an intraday US-session crash (1008). Do NOT extend trend into a stretched swing; watch for the old-direction continuation-collapse.
reasoning_method.magnitude_catalyst_sort: GENERAL: sort the big days by CONDITION, do not rescale. UP-size on weekend-gap Monday, storage Thursday, and swing-reversal/seam day (these carried every large dominant leg in G3/G4/G5 and were all under-forecast). DOWN-size on thin-holiday Monday (Columbus 1013), Sunday carry, and non-catalyst mid-week chop. When catalyst up-sizers coincide, compound them (1020).

plays.trigger: at a BLOCK boundary (the open of a new ~2-week block), when setting the block-level directional lean
plays.read: the running path at a cum-EXTREME (far from the block open) + a counter-move in the old swing's LAST 1-2 days + last-hour momentum into the seam - NOT the calendar seam alone
plays.call: LEAN AGAINST a stretched swing, do NOT extend it. Trigger on SWING EXHAUSTION (cum-extreme + last-1-2-day counter-move), which usually straddles the block boundary but also fires mid-block. The reversal arrives either as a large OVERNIGHT GAP or an INTRADAY US-session crash. Do NOT blind-fade a block that is still trending with no last-day counter-move; confirm with intraday flow/shape.
